# The Minish Cap for macOS 1.2

A new screen filter: **Soft Subpixel**, modelled on the GBA LCD filter of Nintendo Switch Online.

## What's new

- **Soft Subpixel** (⌘6, or Settings → Filters). Each GBA pixel is drawn as blue, green and red stripes with soft
  edges and a thin line between rows. Bright pixels fill out into solid, glowing light with only faint stripes; dark
  pixels keep their stripes. Light bleeds a little between stripes, so a bright green pixel shows a hint of red and
  blue, and colours have the soft, slightly washed-out look of a GBA screen.
- You can adjust subpixel strength, glow, glow radius, colour mixing and brightness in Settings → Filters, on Mac and
  on iPhone/iPad.
- The other filters are unchanged; Sharp Bilinear is still the default.

Everything else is as in 1.1.1.

## Download

`TheMinishCap-1.2-macos-universal.zip`: one app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 12 Monterey or later.
You need your own ROM of The Minish Cap (USA); the app is not signed by a registered developer, so the first time
open it with right-click → Open (the zip's `Read me first.txt` has the steps).
